column1: # The first set, made to choose the style (2026-11-03): Ronald picked this one.

column3: stone|cube|Stone: large sage-grey stone slabs (#4e5250 #707570 #8fa097 #9daea4 #b3c3bb) with deep sage crevices, 6-9 slabs
column4: dirt|cube|Dirt: rounded dirt clods with dark gaps (#483633 #5a433b #6b5342 #856549 #a1815a), 10-15 clods
column5: sand|cube|Sand: very light sand with soft wind ripples and a few white grains (#e0d396 #e4d9a8 #eae0ab #f0e5b6)
column6: gravel|cube|Gravel: separate grey-white pebbles on dark brown (#3e3730 #494336 #534b3d #5a5d58 #aeafa0)

column3: cobblestone|cube|Cobblestone: 8-12 rounded rough cobbles (#393d39 #4f564e #7c8576 #939e8f #a3b3a9) with deep crevices
column4: mossy_cobblestone|cube|Mossy cobblestone: the same sage cobbles with patches of muted green moss (#587827 #75a035)
column5: deepslate@-|cube|Deepslate: purple-grey stone in horizontal layers (#302925 #534d55 #63626c #6d717b #7b8990)
column6: grass_top|grass|Grass block top: leafy grass tufts (#5b733d #708c49 #85a858 #9cc366)

column3: grass_side|grass_side|Grass block side: dirt clods (#483633 #5a433b #6b5342 #856549) under a muted green grass fringe (#5b733d #708c49 #85a858)
column5: log_oak_top|end|Oak log top: honey oak wood with a dark bark rim (#44392b #6a5a41)
column6: leaves_oak|leaves|Oak leaves: muted green oak leaves (#344617 #425a1d #587827 #75a035 #83b23b)

column3: log_spruce|log|Spruce log side: near-black brown bark in rough vertical plates (#221f1f #382b28 #543d34 #62453d)
column4: log_spruce_top|end|Spruce log top: reddish-brown wood (#543d34 #785548 #9a7058) with a dark bark rim
column5: log_birch|log|Birch log side: almost white birch bark (#81786f #b0ada6 #c6c6c1 #d7d7d5 #e4e4e4) with short dark horizontal streaks
column6: log_birch_top|end|Birch log top: pale cream wood with a thin white bark rim

column3: prickly_pear@-|plant|Prickly pear cactus: three flat oval pads stacked, blue-green with tiny pale spine dots, two small dark pink fruits on the top pad's rim, about 24 px tall
column4: cattail@-|plant|Cattail: thin green blade leaves and one tall stem topped by a brown velvety sausage-shaped seed head, full height
column5: mushroom_red@-|plant|Red mushroom: one small plump mushroom (#990d07 #ae1c10, spots #f6e4e1) on a short cream stem, 10-14 px tall
column6: lingonberry_bush_stage_3@-|plant|Lingonberry bush, ripe: a low dense dwarf shrub with small dark green oval leaves and clusters of small shiny red berries, wide, about 16 px tall
